personality_one_liner: Modern, minimal, and highly utilitarian design that frames the natural beauty of plants without distraction.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Don't crowd content. Use intentional whitespace.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content
Floating action buttons or camera controls over viewfinder

screens.name: Início
screens.purpose: Dashboard providing a clear overview of upcoming care routines (watering/fertilizing) and quick task logging.

states.empty: Subtle illustration with text 'Tudo regado por hoje' (All watered for today) and a primary CTA to discover plants.
states.error: Message: 'Erro ao carregar agenda' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Use a personalized plant list with status indicators and an upcoming tasks timeline. Implement quick-action logging buttons for care events (watering) and an AI health scanner entry point. Focus on modular card layouts.

screens.name: Identificador
screens.purpose: Camera UI for plant and disease identification, prioritizing a clean, focused scanning experience.

states.empty: N/A - Camera stream is the default.
states.error: Camera permission error with 'Permitir Câmera' button.

screens.layout: Clean viewfinder with framing guides (reticle) and instructional overlay ('Posicione a planta no quadro'). Keep primary shutter central and accessible, with secondary tools in a control bar. Post-scan should show a confidence score and organize actionable details into segmented cards.

screens.name: Minhas Plantas
screens.purpose: Collection of the user's registered plants showing their status.

states.empty: Image of an empty pot with 'Nenhuma planta cadastrada' and an 'Adicionar Planta' primary CTA.
states.error: Message: 'Não foi possível carregar suas plantas' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Grid or single column layout with generous 'md' margin between items. Display real plant photos where possible. Each card should feature the plant name and next care date.

screens.name: Horta & Guias
screens.purpose: Step-by-step planting guides and vegetable garden (horta) tutorials.

states.error: Message: 'Erro ao carregar guias' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Full-width editorial-style hero cards for featured guides, followed by a searchable library of tutorials. Use real photos for vegetable gardens with a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern to ensure text readability.

screens.name: Detalhes da Planta
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific plant's health, watering schedule reminder setup, and care history.

states.empty: N/A - Data is required to open.
states.error: Message: 'Erro ao carregar detalhes' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a top-to-bottom scrim. Plant title and key metrics (water once a week) overlaid. Below, segment the care instructions and reminder settings into distinct, rounded cards.

onboarding_hero.alt: Minimalist monstera leaf isolated on white

vegetable_garden_hero.alt: Modern vegetable garden with lettuce and chives

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. All text and UI elements must adhere to WCAG AA contrast rules.
Do NOT use generic indigo, blue, or purple colors. We are using an earthy Forest/Moss green (#2E4F2E) paired with neutral sand/off-white colors.
Implement Google Sign-in on the onboarding screen as requested in the problem statement.
When displaying plant images as hero headers or cards, ALWAYS apply a gradient-to-dark vertical scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) so overlaid text is fully readable.
Ensure touch targets for quick-log watering buttons are at least 44x44pt.
Use Phosphor icons. Stick to one weight per screen (outlined default, filled active in tab bar).

Layout learnings: The Home screen should prioritize a timeline/schedule view of upcoming watering tasks. The Camera Identifier needs a clean viewfinder with framing reticle overlays. Post-scan details should use separated metric cards rather than dense text lists.
Translate all labels and UI text strictly into Brazilian Portuguese as instructed.
